title: RNA Isolation and RT-qPCR for Dengue, Chikungunya and Zika Viruses
author: Maria Fernanda Avila Mejia
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bcwyixfw

steps.title: Collect Dried Blood Spots (DBS)
steps.instruction: Collect blood samples on filter paper following strict aseptic and saturation guidelines.

substeps.instruction: Wear gloves and label the filter paper before collection.
Clean the finger with 75% alcohol and allow it to dry.
Perform a fingerprick with a small lancet and apply gentle pressure to allow a large drop of blood to collect.
Allow the blood to drop and saturate the full circle of the filter paper; do not press the paper against the wound and avoid smearing the spot.
Allow blood spots to dry completely.
Place the filter paper in a sealed plastic bag with a desiccant package and store in a closed box, avoiding exposure to the sun.

steps.title: Punch DBS and Extract RNA
steps.instruction: Isolate viral RNA from the dried blood spots.

substeps.instruction: Use a paper puncher to take a 6-mm punch from the dried blood spot.
Sterilize the puncher with fire and make a clean punch after each use to prevent cross-contamination.
Extract viral RNA using the QIAamp Viral RNA Mini Kit according to the manufacturer's instructions.

steps.title: Prepare RT-qPCR Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare three 25 µl final volume PCR mixes using the Quantinova SYBR Green RT-PCR Kit for DENV, CHIKV, and ZIKV.

substeps.instruction: For Dengue (DENV): Mix 5 µL RNA sample, 3.75 µL ddH2O, 12.5 µL SYBR green, 0.25 µL RT Mix, 0.75 µL Primer-F (0.3 µM), 0.75 µL Primer-R1 (0.3 µM), 0.75 µL Primer-R2 (0.3 µM), and 1.25 µL Rox.
For Chikungunya (CHIKV): Mix 5 µL RNA sample, 4.5 µL ddH2O, 12.5 µL SYBR green, 0.25 µL RT Mix, 0.75 µL Primer-F (0.3 µM), 0.75 µL Primer-R (0.3 µM), and 1.25 µL Rox.
For Zika (ZIKV): Mix 5 µL RNA sample, 4 µL ddH2O, 12.5 µL SYBR green, 0.25 µL RT Mix, 1 µL Primer-F (0.4 µM), 1 µL Primer-R (0.4 µM), and 1.25 µL Rox.

steps.title: Run RT-qPCR and Analyze Results
steps.instruction: Process samples in the Applied Biosystems StepOnePlus™ Real-Time PCR System and evaluate positivity based on Cq and melting curves.

substeps.instruction: Run the RT-qPCR process (RT conditions specified as 'RT 5' in text).
Identify positive samples as those where the fluorescence curve crosses the threshold line within 40 cycles (Cq < 40).
Verify positivity via melting curve analysis: DENV-1 (~80.25°C), DENV-2 (~81.75°C), DENV-3 (~80.5°C), DENV-4 (~83°C), and CHIKV/ZIKV (between 81°C and 82°C).
Send all positive samples for sequencing.
